zh.title: ANA控股命名新貨運航空「ANA Nippon Cargo」2027年4月啟航
zh.summary: ANA控股宣布新貨運品牌ANA Nippon Cargo，2027年4月1日正式啟航
body: ANA控股宣布其新整合貨運航空公司名為「ANA Nippon Cargo」，預計2027年4月1日正式啟航。正式公司名稱為「ANA Nippon Cargo Airlines Co., Ltd.」，但啟航初期將暫時保留現有「日本貨物航空株式會社」名稱，完整更名預定在2027財政年度下半年或之後，視政府核准而定。
此新航空公司源自ANA集團三大貨運業務合併：ANA Cargo、日本貨物航空（Nippon Cargo Airlines）及NCA Japan。合併計畫最早於2026年3月發布，屬ANA控股強化全球空運市場地位的核心策略。三家業務合計雇用逾2,100人，銷售據點遍布東京、大阪、福岡、香港、新加坡、曼谷、上海、芝加哥、紐約、阿姆斯特丹、法蘭克福等城市。
日本貨物航空將作為持續營運主體，保留航空運送事業許可與航空運送事業者證書。ANA控股表示新名稱與品牌體現三大意涵：ANA集團統一身份、所謂「日本品質」的服務標準自豪感、以及承接三大業務專業經驗的承諾。「Cargo Airlines」納入公司名稱係為彰顯專職貨運航空、自有機隊、直負安全與服務責任。
ANA控股訂下目標，在中期經營策略中透過貨運重組創造300億日圓（約1.95億美元）整合與協同效益。結合日本貨物航空的專職貨機網絡與ANA國際客運網絡，集團以成為亞洲領先的客貨混合型航空公司為目標。
整合作業已在正式合併前啟動。2026年4月起，集團統一國際貨運銷售架構，建立單一客戶聯繫點；倉庫營運在中部國際機場（NGO）與關西國際機場（KIX）整合，實現貨物集中交接；芝加哥歐海爾國際機場（ORD）到貨處理亦同步整合。NCA集團於2025年8月併入ANA集團，雙方已透過共享貨量與北美、歐洲航線代碼共用深化合作。ANA表示將在2027年4月啟航前進一步公布品牌細節。

en.title: ANA Holdings Names New Cargo Airline ANA Nippon Cargo Launching April 2027
en.summary: ANA Holdings announces new cargo brand ANA Nippon Cargo, launching 1 April 2027
body: ANA Holdings has announced the name of its new consolidated cargo airline as "ANA Nippon Cargo," with a planned launch on 1 April 2027. The formal corporate name will be "ANA Nippon Cargo Airlines Co., Ltd.," though the company will initially retain the existing "Nippon Cargo Airlines Co., Ltd." name at launch, with the full name change scheduled for the second half of fiscal year 2027 or later, pending government approval.

The new airline results from the merger of three ANA Group cargo businesses: ANA Cargo, Nippon Cargo Airlines, and NCA Japan. The consolidation was first announced in March 2026 as part of ANA Holdings' broader effort to strengthen its position in the global air freight market. Together, the combined business employs more than 2,100 people across the three entities and maintains a sales footprint spanning offices in Tokyo, Osaka, Fukuoka, Hong Kong, Singapore, Bangkok, Shanghai, Chicago, New York, Amsterdam, and Frankfurt, among other cities.

Nippon Cargo Airlines will serve as the continuing operating entity, retaining its Air Transport Business License and Air Operator Certificate after the merger takes effect. ANA Holdings said the new name and brand reflect three things: the unified identity of the ANA Group, pride in what the company describes as "Nippon Quality" in its service standards, and a commitment to building on the expertise of all three merging businesses. The inclusion of "Cargo Airlines" in the corporate name was intentional, signalling that this is a dedicated cargo carrier operating its own fleet with direct responsibility for safety and service.

ANA Holdings has set a target of generating JPY 30 billion (US$195 million) in integration and synergy effects as part of its Medium-Term Corporate Strategy, with the cargo reorganisation positioned as a key driver of that goal. By combining Nippon Cargo Airlines' dedicated freighter network with ANA's international passenger network, the group said it aims to become Asia's leading combination carrier.

The integration process began ahead of the formal April 2027 merger date. From April 2026, the group unified its international cargo sales structure, creating a single point of contact for customers across the network regardless of which carrier was operating the flight. Warehouse operations were also consolidated at Chubu Centrair International Airport (NGO) and Kansai International Airport (KIX), allowing centralized cargo drop-off and pick-up. Arrival cargo processing at Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD) was similarly consolidated as part of the early-stage integration work. The NCA Group first joined the ANA Group in August 2025, with the two sides expanding collaboration through shared cargo capacity and codesharing on routes across North America and Europe. ANA said further details on the new brand will be announced closer to the April 2027 launch.
